positives: Overall approach was very practical and no nonsense was experienced during the inspection
style: Checks equipment by trying it out on deck
Looks very closely for rust spots
Checks documentation and lockers very thoroughly

questions.q: What are your actions in case of IG system failure?
What are the wind criteria for cargo operations?
What are your actions in various emergency situations?

checks.item: Heating system for cargo tanks checked very closely
Sample locker checked very thoroughly for PPE and MSDS
Pumproom cargo sea chest arrangement checked for securing
Ballast water treatment system filters inspected
Ship/Shore Safety Checklist checked very thoroughly
Cargo tank pressure alarms tried out

tips: Be ready to demonstrate deck equipment such as HLA, lifeboat and emergency generator
Keep rust spots under control, this inspector looks for them closely
Have sample locker PPE and MSDS in order
Know your IG failure and emergency actions well
summary: Inspection in Morocco by Khalid Mouchta, inspector name and port given but date not stated. He worked through deck, pumproom and CCR with a very practical, no nonsense approach, trying out equipment and checking cargo heating, sample locker and pumproom arrangements closely. He asked about IG failure, wind criteria and emergency actions, and verified LMP and MSMP.
